source: Direct owner message in this project chat, then four product questions answered in the chat
ownerInstruction: Задача - разработать iOS и Android приложение для игроков, чтобы оно мэтчилось с проектом + iOS и iPadOS приложение для DM.
supersedes: docs/FULL_GAME_PLAN.md decision 19 ('native store apps' out of scope) for the apps this program builds; decision 10 (no background push) stands

answers.approach: Нативная оболочка + общий клиент (Recommended): Swift and Kotlin apps whose game screens are the client the server serves; native start, server choice, QR scanner, haptics, keep-awake, sound and notifications; the DM app shows the table display on a TV over AirPlay or HDMI as a screen of its own
answers.backgroundAlerts: Без push-сервисов (Recommended): alerts in the open app, a local notification after a short absence, nothing through Apple or Google servers
answers.tools: Xcode — вы, Android — я (Recommended): the owner installs Xcode from the App Store and runs its sudo set-up; the session installs JDK 21, the Android SDK and an emulator with Homebrew and accepts the Android SDK license for the owner
answers.distribution: Свои устройства, магазины потом (Recommended): installs on the family's own devices (Xcode with the owner's Apple ID, an APK on Android); projects prepared so that store publication is a later step the owner takes

delegation: Product decisions inside the program are delegated to the session and recorded in docs/NATIVE_APPS_PLAN.md and ADR 0070, marked 'Accepted (owner-delegated product decision 2026-11-02)'.
askedAtTheTime: Merges into main, deployments, store publication, developer accounts and signing identities are the owner's and are asked in the chat when they come up.
unchangedBoundaries: World Engine authority: every rule outcome is the server's; the apps compute nothing
knowledge isolation between perspectives, the table display's PARTY perspective included
credentials only as the session cookie the server sets; no tokens or world data in native storage, logs or notifications
no third-party SDKs, analytics or push services
human play acceptance is the owner's and is reported honestly
